title: I cloned my voice and made a hit song — for $10/month

lines.ja: 自分の声でフル曲を60秒で作った

lines.en: Not a demo. A real track — with my actual voice.
lines.ja: デモじゃない、本物の歌声で

lines.en: Professional voice recording normally costs $500 and 3 days.

lines.en: And even then you can't iterate in real-time. Sound familiar?
lines.ja: それでもリアルタイムで修正できない

lines.en: Suno v5.5 just launched with Voices — unlike any AI music tool before it.
First, just type a style and lyrics — it generates a full song in seconds.

lines.en: Then hum or sing a melody into your mic — it turns your hum into a produced track.

lines.en: Follow for the AI tools that actually change your creative output.
